# App Icons and Assets Guide

## iOS App Icon Requirements

### App Store Connect Icons
- **App Store Icon**: 1024 x 1024 pixels (PNG, no transparency)

### Device Icons (Generated by Xcode/Expo)
- **iPhone**: 60pt (120x120, 180x180 pixels)
- **iPad**: 76pt (152x152, 76x76 pixels)
- **iPad Pro**: 83.5pt (167x167 pixels)
- **Settings**: 29pt (58x58, 87x87 pixels)
- **Spotlight**: 40pt (80x80, 120x120 pixels)

## Android App Icon Requirements

### Google Play Store
- **High-res Icon**: 512 x 512 pixels (PNG, 32-bit with alpha)

### Device Icons (Generated by Expo)
- **Launcher Icon**: 48dp, 72dp, 96dp, 144dp, 192dp
- **Adaptive Icon**: Foreground and background layers

## Design Guidelines

### Brand Colors (Durcheap)
- **Primary Blue**: #3B82F6
- **Secondary Purple**: #8B5CF6
- **Accent Orange**: #F59E0B
- **Background White**: #FFFFFF

### Icon Design Principles
1. **Simple and Recognizable**: Clear at small sizes
2. **Brand Consistent**: Use Durcheap colors and style
3. **Platform Native**: Follow iOS and Android guidelines
4. **Scalable**: Works at all required sizes

### Recommended Icon Concept
- Shopping cart with location pin
- Modern, flat design style
- Durcheap brand colors
- Clean typography for "D" letter mark

## Current Asset Status

### Available Assets
- `./assets/icon.png` - 1024x1024 app icon
- `./assets/adaptive-icon.png` - Android adaptive icon foreground
- `./assets/splash.png` - Splash screen image
- `./assets/favicon.png` - Web favicon

### Asset Validation Checklist
- [ ] App icon is 1024x1024 pixels
- [ ] No transparency in App Store icon
- [ ] High contrast and visibility
- [ ] Consistent with brand guidelines
- [ ] Readable at small sizes
- [ ] No text overlay (iOS requirement)
- [ ] Square format (will be rounded by system)

## Splash Screen

### Requirements
- **iOS**: 1170 x 2532 pixels (iPhone 14 Pro)
- **Android**: 1080 x 1920 pixels minimum

### Design Elements
- Durcheap logo centered
- Brand colors as background
- Loading indicator (optional)
- Tagline: "Your Local Marketplace"

## Store Feature Graphics

### iOS App Store
- **iPhone Screenshots**: 1290 x 2796 pixels (6.7" display)
- **iPad Screenshots**: 2048 x 2732 pixels

### Google Play Store
- **Feature Graphic**: 1024 x 500 pixels
- **Phone Screenshots**: 1080 x 1920 pixels minimum
- **Tablet Screenshots**: 1200 x 1920 pixels minimum

## Asset Generation Commands

### Using Expo
```bash
# Generate all required icons from source
npx expo install expo-dev-client

# Build and generate assets
eas build --platform all --non-interactive
```

### Manual Asset Creation
1. Create 1024x1024 master icon in design tool
2. Export as PNG with no transparency
3. Use online icon generators for multiple sizes
4. Test on actual devices for clarity
